correctness.rationale: An exact formal-series inverse of I+zA is constructed columnwise by z^distance S_(LCA-depth). The three exhaustive vertex cases (off-spine, proper ancestor, target) follow from even child parity and S_r+z^2 S_(r-1)=1. Uniqueness of the formal inverse proves every adjacency-power coefficient for all trees and all times. The highest coefficient gives A^(2h)=ell ell^T nonzero and A^(2h+1)=0; the nonzero deepest-level parity functional has exactly half of all inputs. The standalone program checks exhaustive small shapes and nonuniform larger samples, not as a substitute for proof.

originality.rationale: Published tree-automata sources address infinite regular rooted-tree shifts, surjectivity, entropy, or one-step reversibility, without the claimed all-time finite undirected tree adjacency kernel. Searches for parity of rooted-tree walks, characteristic-two adjacency powers, LCA formulas, and even branching found no equivalent theorem; this supports bounded originality only, not an assertion of uniqueness. Results about binary parity dynamics on cubes and multipartite graphs apply to different adjacency operators and do not imply this formula.
residual_risks: Historical uniqueness cannot be guaranteed against unindexed older characteristic-two tree spectra, matching-polynomial or graph-walk literature.

value.rationale: An exact all-time pairwise walk parity identity on arbitrarily shaped finite even-branching trees is a structural solution to a natural finite-field dynamics question, much stronger than a small graph census or routine eigenvalue calculation. It proves an exact nilpotency index growing linearly with height, an explicit rank-one penultimate update and a universal half-of-all-initial-states sharp survival fraction. The formula is unexpectedly independent of all even branching multiplicities, hence useful as a complete propagation and extinction law and as a check on finite graph parity dynamics.
